correctness.rationale: All 27 fixed boundary-color triples obey an exact recursive minimum and multiplicity identity. The invariant three energy classes (x,x+1,x+2) are verified at depth two and preserved by a complete three-case central-color enumeration, yielding the all-generation count. The log-count expansion follows from scalar positive recurrences with proven superexponential ratio growth and vanishing tail errors. Independent exhaustive and dynamic-programming implementations agree through their certified finite ranges; none substitutes for the induction.

value.rationale: On a canonical hierarchically triangulated planar network, three-state antiferromagnetism is the smallest Potts extension of the known Ising model but still cannot properly color the embedded tetrahedron. Exact minimum-defect ground-state degeneracy and residual entropy are natural observables; the proven \(2^t\) negative finite-size entropy term reveals a nontrivial fractal correction on system size \(N\sim3^t/2\), beyond textbook chromatic counting or routine parameter substitution.
